draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.67, the 227th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 16th of 18 at TE. He went 227th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 222 receiving yards in 2021, 15th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.
